comments.body:
I cant see the freeink changes on the main branch.

Also, 
> "No card" when nothing is mounted

is redundent, since the reader wont let you access the settings (or anything else) if no card is presented.

> No card: instead of dropping the row, the device now boots without a card. Settings keep their defaults and are not saved, the library is empty, and About shows "No card". Before this change it stopped on "SD card error". Recovery mode (Down + Power) still needs a card; without one the device boots normally.

I'm against this change. It has its reasons.

> Four more are ready: Screen Cleaning submenu, screen calibration, delayed image redraws, Home / control-center cleaning. If you want the project to grow, 5 feels low for active contributors. Could you raise it?

IT was intentional. A relatively-new restriction after new contributors opened dozens of AI-generated PRs without even verifying on actual device. I fear it also apply to you, as your description says you only tested in the simulator. Do you have an actual device?

> I'd also ask you to reconsider the blanket bias against AI tools. What matters is whether the author checks the work on a real device, not which tools helped write it.

I dont have any bias against AI tolls, I use them myself heavily. What I do want is accountability. If you contribute code you should understand what it does, how it does it and why it does it. It's more than just checking everything seems to work on the surface. 

> To be clear: if the bias and the dismissive tone continue, I'll stop contributing to CrossPoint and keep developing my own fork.

I'm sorry if my tone was too harsh. It wasn't intended.
I merged your SDK PR. Update the submodule pointer.
